title.en: From predictive foundation to an improvement loop
title.zh: 从预测基础到自我改进闭环

caption.en: The opening overview places a shared predictive design underneath domain-specific tasks and a feedback loop above them. This is a conceptual map, rather than a result plot.
caption.zh: 开篇总览把共享的预测设计放在底层，把各领域任务与反馈闭环联系起来。这是一张概念地图，并非实验结果图。

en: Start at JEPA-Anything: the inherited contribution is a way to construct latent predictive models across different data types. RSI-Anything adds rules for using predictions and retaining changes.

Follow the outward path into different domains. Each domain still supplies its own states, actions, prediction targets, feedback and evaluation; a shared mechanism does not imply one universal trained predictor.
Follow feedback back toward the system. An observed outcome can improve the policy or persistent workflow, and can justify an attempt to adapt the predictor.
The closing arrow represents the retained policy–model pair shaping later experience. Saving more observations alone is not a change to either component.
zh: 先看 JEPA-Anything：继承的是跨数据类型构建潜在预测模型的设计。RSI-Anything 增加了如何使用预测、如何保留系统变化的规则。
再沿路径看不同领域。每个领域仍要自行定义状态、动作、预测目标、反馈与评估；共享机制不等于一个训练好的通用预测器包办所有任务。
沿反馈路径返回系统。观察到的结果可以改进策略或持久工作流，也可能为一次预测器适配尝试提供理由。
闭合箭头表示：保留下来的策略与模型组合会改变下一轮经验。仅仅存下更多观察，并不等于策略或模型发生了更新。

title.en: The six operations and the three decisions
title.zh: 六步操作与三个不同的决定

caption.en: The central framework separates choosing an action, deciding whether to attempt an update, and accepting a proposed system version. Its domain panel shows different bindings of this common contract.
caption.zh: 核心框架区分了选择动作、决定是否尝试更新，以及接受哪个系统版本。下方领域面板展示同一机制的不同具体绑定。

en: Read panel a from candidate proposals to predictions and selection. Several candidates may be forecast, while only an executed candidate produces its paired external observation.
Keep the prediction beside the observation, with the action, context and system version that generated it. Without that pairing, a failure cannot be attributed to the predictor used in the decision.

The update branch has separate policy and model pathways. World-model adaptation requires an unreliable assessment, sufficient adaptation data and enough budget; insufficient coverage is a separate state.

Acceptance is another decision. A proposed component must pass its own check, and the assembled policy–model pair must pass a compatibility check before being retained; pair failure preserves the previous pair.
Panel b is a map of applications, not evidence that every application exercised all update pathways. Read it together with Table 4.
zh: 先从 a 面板的候选生成读到预测与选择。可以预测多个候选，但只有真正执行的候选能产生与其配对的外部观察。
把预测和观察并排记录，同时保留动作、上下文与产生预测的系统版本。缺少这种配对，就无法判断决策时使用的预测器究竟哪里出了问题。
更新分支中的策略与世界模型可以各自行动。模型适配需要同时满足“不可靠、有足够适配数据、预算足够”；覆盖不足是另一个状态。
验收是第三个决定。候选组件先通过各自检查，组装后的策略与模型还要通过兼容性检查才能保留；组合不通过则保留原组合。
b 面板展示应用地图，并不说明每个应用都实际执行了全部更新路径；需要结合 Table 4 阅读。

title.en: Code repair: isolate selection and predictor adaptation
title.zh: 代码修复：分离选择收益与预测器适配收益

caption.en: The code study keeps the code-generating policy fixed, making it useful for separating predictive candidate selection from further improvement of the predictor.
caption.zh: 代码实验固定了代码生成策略，因此适合分开理解：预测引导选择带来多少收益，进一步适配预测器又带来多少收益。

en: Panel a is an illustrative program repair. It draws three example patches for readability, but the benchmark actually proposes four revisions per round and allows at most three feedback rounds.

Read panel b together with Table 2: static verification gives 26.3% hidden-test success, fixed world-model selection 29.2%, and world-model adaptation 31.2%. The generator remains ReasonFlux-Coder-7B.

Panel c checks the link from prediction to decisions. In the static-verifier versus fixed-WM comparison, ranking accuracy rises from 66.5% to 72.8% and Brier score falls from 0.488 to 0.358; the adaptive arm is not the arm in this diagnostic.
Panel d checks feedback usage: online test-suite calls per task remain about 3.7. This supports similar external test usage, rather than equal total training or inference computation.

Panels e and f extend selection evaluation to APPS Introductory and LiveCodeBench v6. Their 46.37% and 33.05% metrics are mean complete-suite success across three seeds; do not substitute public-test success.
zh: a 面板是程序修复示意图。为便于阅读只画了三个补丁，但基准实验每轮实际提出四个修订，最多进行三轮反馈。
把 b 面板与 Table 2 一起读：静态验证器的隐藏测试成功率为 26.3%，固定世界模型为 29.2%，适配世界模型为 31.2%；生成器始终是 ReasonFlux-Coder-7B。
c 面板检查“预测是否有助于决策”。静态验证器与固定世界模型比较时，排序准确率从 66.5% 升到 72.8%，Brier 分数从 0.488 降到 0.358；这里不是适配模型的诊断结果。
d 面板检查反馈用量：每题在线测试套件调用约为 3.7 次。这说明外部测试用量相近，不能据此说总训练与推理计算量完全相同。
e、f 面板把选择评估扩展到 APPS Introductory 与 LiveCodeBench v6。46.37% 与 33.05% 是三个种子的完整测试套件成功率均值，不能替换成公开测试通过率。

title.en: GUI results: read success, actions and errors together
title.zh: GUI 结果：成功率、动作与错误要一起看

caption.en: The GUI figure combines two environments and several diagnostics. Relative improvements on OSWorld use a different unit from the percentage-point changes between MiniWoB++ success rates.
caption.zh: GUI 图同时展示两个环境与多项诊断。OSWorld 使用相对提升百分比，其单位不同于 MiniWoB++ 成功率之间的百分点差。

en: Panels a and b illustrate a checkbox task and a spreadsheet task. They explain what an action and an observable target state mean, rather than reporting a single shared benchmark.
Panel c shows MiniWoB++ selected-controller success of 51%, 79% and 99% across three evaluated configurations. The world-based control follows a separate 49%, 96%, 98% sequence.

Read panels e–g jointly: the intermediate configuration uses only 2.93 actions on average but has 21 incorrect-submission episodes. The final configuration uses 3.21 actions and has only one such episode.
The 39.4% action reduction compares 5.30 baseline actions with 3.21 final actions. It is a relative reduction in actions, not a 39.4-percentage-point success gain.
OSWorld gains are relative: RSI-Anything is +18.4% versus the initial agent and +5.5% versus RLAnything. The figure does not supply an absolute success rate from which to claim an 18.4-point gain.

The official repository further separates development-selected policy ranking from pure world-based ranking. The 99% selected-controller endpoint should not be treated as an isolated ablation of world-model ranking.
zh: a、b 面板分别示意复选框任务与电子表格任务，帮助理解动作与可观察目标状态；它们不是一个共同基准中的两张截图。
c 面板给出 MiniWoB++ 选定控制器三个配置的成功率：51%、79%、99%。世界模型排序控制组另有 49%、96%、98% 的结果。
e–g 要联合阅读：中间配置平均只用 2.93 个动作，却有 21 个错误提交回合；最终配置平均 3.21 个动作，错误提交仅 1 个。
动作减少 39.4% 比较的是基线 5.30 与最终 3.21；这是动作数量的相对降幅，不是成功率增加 39.4 个百分点。
OSWorld 使用相对提升：相对初始智能体提高 18.4%，相对 RLAnything 提高 5.5%。图中没有给出足以把它解释成 18.4 个百分点的绝对成功率。
官方仓库还区分了开发集选定的策略排序与纯世界模型排序。99% 的选定控制器端点，不能当成单独隔离世界模型排序作用的消融证据。

title.en: Lab planning: follow retained policy versions
title.zh: 实验室规划：跟踪保留的策略版本

caption.en: This figure follows five versions of one 4B policy in development order on the same 200-task F200 Level-2 benchmark. The score measures plan alignment, not successful robot execution.
caption.zh: 本图在相同的 200 任务 F200 Level-2 基准上，按开发顺序比较一个 4B 策略的五个版本。评分衡量计划对齐程度，并非机器人执行成功率。

en: Panel a connects a protocol, proposed action sequences and parameter choices to predictive evaluation and an execution plan. Dashed arrows represent possible update routes in the framework.
Panels b and c follow five retained policy versions: 21.80%, 38.03%, 41.99%, 44.56% and 46.01%. The total increase is 24.21 percentage points.
Final Score combines action-sequence similarity and parameter accuracy. Read 46.01% as a benchmark score, rather than the fraction of wet-lab experiments completed successfully.
The dashed 45.32% line is the Actor–Simulator–Selector reference. The last version is higher by 0.69 percentage points; model size alone does not control all resources in the compared systems.
The x-axis is development order with schematic spacing. It does not report equal training cost per version, and the plotted progression does not by itself measure a jointly improving predictor.
zh: a 面板把实验规程、候选动作序列与参数选择，接到预测评估和执行计划。虚线表示框架中可能启用的更新路径。
Final Score 结合动作序列相似度与参数准确度。46.01% 是基准评分，不能理解为湿实验成功完成比例。
45.32% 虚线是 Actor–Simulator–Selector 参考系统。最终版本高出 0.69 个百分点；比较模型大小并不意味着其他资源全部受控。
横轴表示开发顺序，间距只是示意，不代表每个版本耗费相同训练成本；这条上升曲线本身也没有量化世界模型与策略共同进步。

title.en: Reaction search: match budgets within each screen
title.zh: 反应搜索：在各自筛选内匹配实验预算

caption.en: The two halves concern separate Suzuki–Miyaura screening protocols. Each endpoint compares methods at the same observation count within its own screen.
caption.zh: 上下两部分是两个独立的 Suzuki–Miyaura 筛选协议。每个端点只在其所属筛选内部，用相同观察次数比较方法。

en: Read panels a–c as the GC screen: after 20 observations, the best observed yield is 93.0% for RSI-Anything and 87.5% for Bayesian optimization, a difference of 5.5 percentage points.
Read panels d–f separately as the flow LC–MS screen: after 40 observations, mean best observed yield is 96.15% versus 82.16%, a difference of 13.99 percentage points.
A best-so-far curve cannot decrease: it remembers the highest measured yield seen so far. It is not a claim that every next experiment has a higher yield.
The chemical structures and arrows explain condition choice and feedback. They do not establish that every observation caused a neural-network weight update.

The official flow-screen release replays measured yields from a fixed pool of 321 conditions with eight initial observations included in the budget of 40. Its prediction table remains frozen while feedback changes expected-improvement selection.
These screen-specific results support efficient search in the reported pools and budgets; they do not establish transfer to arbitrary reactions, or the performance of an autonomous laboratory.
zh: a–c 单独看作 GC 筛选：20 次观察后，RSI-Anything 的已观察最佳产率为 93.0%，贝叶斯优化为 87.5%，相差 5.5 个百分点。
d–f 单独看作流动 LC–MS 筛选：40 次观察后，平均已观察最佳产率为 96.15% 与 82.16%，相差 13.99 个百分点。
“至今最佳”曲线不会下降，因为它记录此前见过的最高实测产率；这并不表示每次后续实验的产率都更高。
化学结构和箭头解释条件选择与反馈，不足以证明每次观察都会引起神经网络权重更新。
官方流动筛选发布版本从 321 个条件的固定池中顺序回放实测产率，40 次预算包含初始 8 次观察。预测表保持冻结，反馈改变的是期望改进的选择。
这些结果支持在论文筛选池与预算内提高搜索效率，尚不能推出对任意反应的迁移能力，也不能等同于自主实验室的整体表现。

title.en: Immune science: construction and analysis are different stages
title.zh: 免疫科学：模型构建与下游分析分阶段

caption.en: The application joins scientific-workflow evolution, immune-world-model construction and downstream analysis. Its final therapeutic combination is a hypothesis awaiting experimental validation.
caption.zh: 该应用把科学工作流演化、免疫世界模型构建和下游分析连接起来。最终治疗组合是等待实验验证的假设。

en: Read panel A in stages. During construction, workflow search selects a persistent model-building workflow; that workflow produces the immune predictor.
During downstream analysis, the constructed predictor is frozen. The analysis state, tool use, intervention candidates and hypothesis ranking can still change through inference and self-correction.
Panel B makes the action-conditioned prediction concrete: cellular, tissue and individual contexts form the state, while an intervention supplies the action whose consequences are forecast.
Measured perturbations support development and withheld interventions or contexts assess forecasting. A predicted biological readout and a measured outcome retain different evidential roles.
The SIRPα inhibition plus IL-36γ-axis modulation nomination is prospective. Neither this framework diagram nor the paper establishes therapeutic efficacy in clinical use.
zh: A 面板要分阶段读：构建阶段通过工作流搜索，选择持久的模型构建工作流，再由该工作流产出免疫预测器。
下游分析时预测器冻结。分析状态、工具调用、干预候选和假设排序，仍可通过推理与自我纠正发生变化。
B 面板具体解释动作条件预测：细胞、组织与个体上下文构成状态，干预是动作，模型预测其后果。
实测扰动数据支持模型开发，留出的干预或上下文检验预测。模型产生的生物读出与实测结果承担不同的证据角色。
SIRPα 抑制与 IL-36γ 轴调节的组合是前瞻性提名。本框架图和论文都没有建立其临床治疗有效性。

method.zh: 容量匹配的静态验证器

policy.en: ReasonFlux-Coder-7B is fixed; four revisions are proposed per round.
policy.zh: ReasonFlux-Coder-7B 固定，每轮生成四个修订。

worldModel.en: W1: JEPA-Anything-based Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct with LoRA; predicts five-class execution probabilities. Compare fixed W1 with feedback-adapted W1.
worldModel.zh: W1：基于 JEPA-Anything 设计、以 LoRA 适配 Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct，预测五类执行概率；比较固定 W1 与反馈适配 W1。

feedback.en: Online execution-test feedback; final hidden-suite success and online calls per task.
feedback.zh: 在线执行测试反馈；最终隐藏测试成功率与每题在线调用次数。

limit.en: Isolates selection and predictor adaptation with a fixed generator. Similar online calls do not establish equal total compute.
limit.zh: 固定生成器，分离选择与预测器适配收益；在线调用相近不等于总计算量相同。

policy.en: Action policy is updated from interaction; retained pairs are evaluated as baseline, adapted and final configurations.
policy.zh: 通过交互更新动作策略；评估基线、适配与最终保留组合。

worldModel.en: GUI outcome predictor forecasts interface-action consequences and is updated with interaction feedback.
worldModel.zh: GUI 结果预测器预测界面动作后果，并根据交互反馈更新。

feedback.en: Task outcomes; strict completion and action/error diagnostics.
feedback.zh: 任务结果；严格任务完成率以及动作与错误诊断。

limit.en: MiniWoB++ checkbox results and OSWorld relative gains are separate evaluations. Repository selected-controller ranking and world-based control must be distinguished.
limit.zh: MiniWoB++ 复选框结果与 OSWorld 相对提升来自不同评估；仓库中的选定控制器排序需与世界模型排序控制组区分。

policy.en: One 4B planning policy, followed through five consecutive retained versions.
policy.zh: 跟踪同一个 4B 规划策略的五个连续保留版本。

worldModel.en: JEPA-Anything-based protocol predictor forecasts consequences of action sequences. The reported progression follows policy versions.
worldModel.zh: 基于 JEPA-Anything 的规程预测器预测动作序列后果；所报告的上升过程跟踪策略版本。

feedback.en: Development feedback; Level-1 next-action accuracy and 200-task F200 Level-2 Final Score.
feedback.zh: 开发反馈；Level-1 下一动作准确度与 200 任务 F200 Level-2 Final Score。

limit.en: Protocol-aligned planning, not verified physical execution; no direct joint policy–model improvement curve.
limit.zh: 衡量规程对齐规划，并非已验证的物理执行；没有直接给出策略与模型共同进步的曲线。

policy.en: Measured yields guide later condition choices; history and acquisition change across observations.
policy.zh: 实测产率引导后续条件选择，历史记录与采集函数随观察变化。

worldModel.en: ReactionT5–JEPA-Anything predicts a yield distribution. The released flow-screen selector uses frozen calibrated predictions.
worldModel.zh: ReactionT5–JEPA-Anything 预测产率分布；发布的流动筛选选择器使用冻结的校准预测。

feedback.en: GC or LC–MS measured yields; best-so-far metrics at matched observation budgets within each screen.
feedback.zh: GC 或 LC–MS 实测产率；在各筛选内部匹配观察预算比较至今最佳指标。

limit.en: Two different screens; the current flow release replays one measured condition pool. Feedback-guided search alone is not evidence of online weight adaptation.
limit.zh: 两个不同筛选；当前流动发布版本回放一个实测条件池。反馈引导搜索本身不证明在线权重适配。

policy.en: Scientific workflow evolution selects a model-building workflow; downstream analysis revises interventions and hypotheses.
policy.zh: 科学工作流演化选择模型构建工作流；下游分析修改干预与假设。

worldModel.en: Constructed immune world model predicts multiscale transitions and biological readouts; parameters are fixed during downstream analysis.
worldModel.zh: 构建的免疫世界模型预测多尺度转移与生物读出；下游分析期间参数固定。

feedback.en: Measured perturbations for development; withheld interventions and contexts for forecasting assessment.
feedback.zh: 实测扰动用于开发；留出的干预与上下文用于预测评估。

limit.en: Construction and analysis have different update scopes. The proposed therapeutic combination awaits experiments.
limit.zh: 构建与分析的更新范围不同；提出的治疗组合仍需实验验证。

en: Different applications evaluate different parts of the framework. Sustained mutual policy–world-model improvement in one task requires joint multiround evaluation (§5).
An update-and-acceptance cycle can leave both versions unchanged. Appending experience is not itself a policy or predictor revision (§2.1).
Insufficient observational coverage is not evidence of reliability and does not activate the model-adaptation trigger (§2.4).
Training data, gate data and any held-out final audit have different roles. Accepted performance on a gate does not establish unseen-task generalization (§2.5).
Similar external test calls and matched experiment counts control feedback use, not every source of computation or every possible experimental cost (§3, §6).
GUI relative gains, percentage-point differences, action reductions and planning scores have distinct units and denominators (§3.2–3.3).

The chemistry screens are separate protocols. The current flow-screen release uses a frozen prediction table and sequential replay of measured yields, rather than online retraining at each observation (official repository).
Laboratory planning needs equipment-level execution evaluation; the immune-science therapeutic nomination awaits experimental testing (§5).
All small numerical examples and interactive mechanisms on this learning site are educational syntheses unless explicitly labeled as paper measurements.
zh: 各应用验证的是框架的不同部分。要证明同一任务中策略与世界模型持续相互促进，仍需联合多轮评估（§5）。
一次更新与验收周期可以让两个版本都保持不变。追加经验本身不是策略或预测器修订（§2.1）。
观察覆盖不足不等于模型可靠，也不会触发模型适配（§2.4）。
训练数据、验收数据与最终留出审计承担不同角色。通过验收集不等于已建立对新任务的泛化能力（§2.5）。
在线测试调用相近、实验次数相同，控制的是外部反馈用量，不是全部计算量或所有实验成本（§3、§6）。
GUI 相对提升、百分点差、动作降幅与规划评分的单位及分母不同（§3.2–3.3）。
化学两个筛选使用不同协议。当前流动筛选发布版本使用冻结预测表并顺序回放实测产率，不是在每次观察后在线重训（官方仓库）。
实验室规划还需设备层面的执行验证；免疫科学中的治疗组合仍等待实验检验（§5）。
学习网站中的小型数值例子和交互机制，除非明确标为论文实测，否则均为教学综合示例。
